name: epoch
cooked: RocksDB is a direction that several alt-nodes are converging on. My effort (satd) uses it as well, but a more conventional storage philosophy patterned after Core. Not focused on space optimization specifically though that’s a good area to explore considering many implementations are now adding indices as well which increases storage demand.
